name: AI for Fleet Safety Managers: Telematics, Video Safety and FMCSA Compliance
description: Ninety days at Bramblecreek Freight Lines, a composite 150-truck Illinois carrier facing an 18% insurance increase and an FMCSA warning letter. You clear the AI dash-cam backlog, answer a 2:14 a.m. drowsiness alert, coach from reviewed facts, resolve unidentified driving, audit DQ files, build a post-crash evidence pack and turn on driver-facing cameras in three states. AI sorts, extracts and drafts; the FMCSRs keep each decision with a named person.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Transport, Logistics and Mobility

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for Fleet Safety Managers: Telematics, Video Safety and FMCSA Compliance

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 17 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
